# Twi097 — Edge-projection-aux range computation loses precision on periodic curves

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

## Description

An edge whose host curve is periodic (circle, ellipse, closed B-spline) reports a parameter range that traverses the period seam. A range-validation step adjusts the range, but on periodic curves a naive range adjustment that wraps to `[0, 2π)` loses the original sense (going the long way vs the short way around). The healed edge then represents a different arc than the original.

## Reproducer recipe

Edge on a circle from parameter `t=5.5` to `t=1.0` (i.e., the long way around through `t=2π` then to `t=1.0`). After range validation the edge becomes `[1.0, 5.5]` (short way), reversing the arc.

## Expected kernel behavior

range-validation on periodic curves preserves the original arc-traversal direction; never flip orientation as a side effect of range normalisation.
